proof_dependency_chain: Local solution geometry: Nonempty finite-dimensional affine section sets with equivariant kernel-map direction spaces.
Linked solution system: Affine transition maps on section sets; these may be nonsurjective.
Stabilization: Nonempty eventual image sets without treating the field as finite or the spaces as compact.
Coherent selection: One coherent equivariant section family.
Limit assembly: An equivariant section of q_infinity and the compatible direct-sum isomorphism.
Complete freedom and transport: A nonempty affine solution space under Hom_G(C,A_infinity), with natural transport but no preferred point.
